name: AI Discovery Scout
description: LLM proposes likely-authoritative URLs per entity from model knowledge, then verifies every URL live (HEAD/GET) before it enters the pool. The verification gate is the anti-hallucination guard. Executes no search-API calls (that is search-discovery's job).
usage_notes: The scout PROPOSES from model knowledge (zero search cost, works where search is noisy); search-discovery FINDS via a search index (grounded, costs per query). Complementary — the scout runs no search API. All vertical flavor (which platforms/directories to prioritize) lives in the `prompt` preset, not code. Verification is ON by default (keep_unverified=false) — an LLM will confidently invent plausible URLs. Needs the skeleton's tools.ai (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) to run.

options.name: prompt
options.label: Discovery prompt
options.description: Instruction to the LLM. Placeholders: {entity_name}, {entity_website}, {entity_context} (extra entity columns), {max}. Must ask for strict JSON: an array of {url, lead_type, rationale, confidence}. ALL vertical flavor (which platforms/directories/registers to prioritize) belongs here via a template preset — the default carries none (Rule 13).
options.default: List up to {max} URLs likely to contain authoritative information about the entity below: its own key pages and its profile pages on major public platforms. Return strict JSON: an array of objects [{"url": "...", "lead_type": "...", "rationale": "...", "confidence": 0.0}]. lead_type is a short free-text label (e.g. official, profile, reference). confidence is 0.0-1.0. Only include URLs you are confident actually exist. Return ONLY the JSON array, no prose, no markdown, no code fences.

options.name: ai_model
options.label: AI Model
options.description: Model for lead proposal. Haiku-class is the cheap default (testing convention); switch to sonnet/opus for higher-quality proposals in production.

options.name: ai_provider
options.label: AI Provider
options.description: Which LLM provider tools.ai routes to.

options.name: max_urls_per_entity
options.label: Max URLs per entity
options.description: Cap on leads proposed + verified per entity. Also interpolated into the prompt as {max}.

options.name: min_confidence
options.label: Minimum confidence
options.description: Drop leads whose model confidence is below this BEFORE verification (saves HTTP calls). 0 = keep all.

options.name: keep_unverified
options.label: Keep unverified leads
options.description: false (default) = drop URLs that don't verify live (the anti-hallucination gate). true = keep them flagged verified:false — only safe with a Step-2 filter behind it.

options.name: emit_suggested_queries
options.label: Emit suggested search queries
options.description: Ask the LLM to ALSO return search-query strings (operator metadata for feeding search-discovery). Output goes to meta.suggested_queries only, never the pool.

options.name: verification_timeout
options.label: Verification timeout (ms)
options.description: Per-URL HEAD/GET timeout during liveness verification.

options.name: max_concurrent_verifications
options.label: Max concurrent verifications
options.description: How many URL liveness checks run in parallel per entity.
